title: Two collected quest items permanently describe wanting to be joined with each other even though both sit in inventory together from the moment the second is found through the end of the game, and 'The White Rod' quest is marked Done the instant both are collected. Inventory shows, unchanged for ~450 turns and through the ending: 'the white rod's shaft, ferrule missing (wants its ferrule, dug from the herald's walk, to be made whole)' and 'the white rod's ferrule, dug clean (wants the shaft it was struck from, kept by Hew at the ditch-gate)' — the ferrule's own text even claims the shaft is still 'kept by Hew at the ditch-gate' long after Hew handed it over.
where: Truce Field — the Herald's Walk / inventory display

evidence.quote: After walking the assembled rod out at dusk ("You fit the ferrule to the shaft, speak the truce-words whole, and walk the rod out into the furrow at dusk"), both component items stay in inventory with unchanged, now-false text: 'the white rod's ferrule, dug clean (wants the shaft it was struck from, kept by Hew at the ditch-gate)' and 'the white rod's shaft, ferrule missing (wants its ferrule, dug from the herald's walk, to be made whole)' — this persists even into the final win-state status screen, though the ending text itself says 'the rod made whole.'

Two collected quest items permanently describe wanting to be joined with each other even though both sit in inventory together from the moment the second is found through the end of the game, and 'The White Rod' quest is marked Done the instant both are collected. Inventory shows, unchanged for ~450 turns and through the ending: 'the white rod's shaft, ferrule missing (wants its ferrule, dug from the herald's walk, to be made whole)' and 'the white rod's ferrule, dug clean (wants the shaft it was struck from, kept by Hew at the ditch-gate)' — the ferrule's own text even claims the shaft is still 'kept by Hew at the ditch-gate' long after Hew handed it over.
